main_body: Rounded leaf canopy on a thin trunk, with a small grass patch at the base
top_band: none: the column starts with dark green (L~54) at the canopy top and gets lighter toward the bottom (L~149 at rows 32-35). No lighter horizontal top surface sits above a front face.
evidence: The canopy is a single rounded blob whose lightness runs from dark at the top to light at the bottom, so it reads as a front-facing sprite. No top band, front-edge line or step to a separate front face can be pointed at in the scan. The trunk is a narrow vertical stem. Under the strict rule, no top surface is clearly drawn, so it fails.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 12 distinct colours and a median of 6 per tile, against about 108 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. Its 5 greens (L 42, 55, 83, 116, 149) form a coarse, dithered ramp with no per-leaf clumps, branch detail or visible trunk and root structure. The dark edge pixels are green-tinted, not neutral, and there are no flat fills. Even so, the tree is far thinner and flatter than the Beodeul references.
